title: Speciesist bias in AI: How AI applications perpetuate discrimination and unfair outcomes against animals

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing image classification accuracy for free-range vs. factory-farmed animals; analyzing cosine similarities in word embeddings (GloVe, Word2Vec) between different animal categories (farmed, companion, non-companion) and valence or mind-denial terms; and probing large language models (GPT-3, Delphi) using short Q&A tasks, underspecified questions, and moral judgment scenarios.
